Name: Berodach-Baladan, King of Babylon
Summary: Berodach-Baladan, son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a present to Hezekiah when he heard he had been sick, and Hezekiah showed him all his treasures.
RelatedPeople: King Hezekiah; Baladan, Father of Berodach-Baladan
LifeLesson: Showing off treasure to a foreign embassy invites the embassy's army.
